evidence.observation: T held at 749.8 °C against a 750 setpoint; the brief overshoot to 760 °C at t=2520 had settled by t=2760
Heater power steady at about 45% during the hold, as expected
Argon flow 99.9 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint
Pressure steady near 760.5 Torr throughout the run
Sensor not installed, although the growth stage requires it; air getting in near atmospheric pressure would not show on the pressure gauge

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading or another atmosphere check, such as a leak-rate or pressure-hold test, is needed to rule out oxygen contamination during growth. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
